description: One buyable configuration of one vehicle model as a manufacturer's UK site offers it: version, trim, price, powertrain, body facts and the colours it can be had in.

version.description: The version as the site names it, e.g. 'BYD SEAL 2026' or 'Air SR 58.3kWh 201bhp 1-Speed Auto (FWD)'.

trim.description: The trim level: Design, Excellence, Air, GT-Line...

configuration.description: The option combination this price is for (colour / interior / wheels), when the site prices combinations.

engine.description: Motor or engine description: power, battery, gearbox, drive.

colours.description: Every exterior colour available for this version.
